result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback position: it provides a mutual cap based on 12 months’ fees, preserves the Section 8 carve-out (apparently indemnification), and adds uncapped confidentiality, gross-negligence, and wilful-misconduct claims. It also moves toward the preferred position by covering paid-or-payable fees and adding fraud, IP-infringement, and payment-obligation treatment. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks the USD 1,000,000 floor and data-protection/security carve-outs. The changes are targeted and preserve the mutual damages exclusion and general risk allocation. Drafting quality is materially reduced by the unrepaired duplicated, malformed paragraph beginning '10 LIABILITY RELATES' and by using 'not subject to this limitation' for payment obligations rather than clearly stating that such obligations are not damages subject to the cap.
